title: One frozen caption-RAG HM3D case score
description: One JSONL record. Every case_id must also occur in the canonical SafeVantage rows.

case_id.description: Stable case key shared with the canonical score rows.

score.description: Frozen caption-RAG score used to select Yes, No, or Abstain thresholds.

scene_id.description: Optional scene key; if supplied, must match canonical rows.

gt_present.description: Optional binary ground truth; if supplied, must match canonical rows.
